definition: a large area of sea almost enclosed by land
description: On a rocky hilltop high above the sea, a man in a red jacket, black helmet and sunglasses runs off the rock as an orange paraglider wing fills above him. He lifts into the air and floats away over a turquoise gulf of calm water, almost closed in by green hilly headlands with white houses, while the open sea shines in the sun beyond. Two people stand near a striped windsock on the slope below and watch him as he flies further out and gets smaller.

taps.target: the man in the red jacket
